title: Senior Catalog Manager & PIM - Travel & Hospitality Tech
description:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

Our client is an award-winning, leading strategic digital communications and transformation agency operating at the intersection of enterprise-grade technology and creative delivery. As a critical hub within a premier global digital services and marketing network, they collaborate directly with major regional brands, government entities, and large-scale destination enterprises to architect high-impact digital experiences. They specialize in driving large-scale digital transformation across the hospitality, tourism, travel, and commerce sectors.


Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Product Catalog & PIM is a highly strategic business owner and subject matter expert responsible for establishing, governing, and optimizing the enterprise product catalog strategy. This role leads the end-to-end evaluation, design, onboarding, and implementation of a centralized Product Information Management (PIM) ecosystem—specifically utilizing tools like Akeneo—and unifies it wi
resumen: Rol de Senior Manager de catálogo de productos y sistema PIM (Product Information Management) para una agencia de transformación digital en hospitality/travel. Es un puesto centrado en gestión de datos de productos, gobernanza de catálogos y herramientas como Akeneo — más cercano a Product/Data Management que a análisis de datos o ciencia de datos.
por_que_encaja: Hay un componente de gestión de datos estructurados y gobernanza que toca áreas familiares, pero el rol es esencialmente de Product Information Management y estrategia de catálogo — no análisis de datos, BI, forecasting ni data science. El fit es muy bajo.
brecha_stack: El rol requiere experiencia profunda en PIM (especialmente Akeneo), gestión de catálogos de productos a escala enterprise, y liderazgo de equipos de datos de producto. Nahuel no tiene background en PIM ni en gestión de catálogos — su experiencia es en analytics, forecasting y BI, que son dominios completamente distintos.
posibilidad_real: Baja — El rol pide un especialista en PIM/catálogos que Nahuel no es. Aplicar sería perder tiempo.
red_flags: El rol es de 'Senior Manager' de PIM/catálogo — especialización muy específica que Nahuel no tiene
Herramienta clave requerida (Akeneo) es desconocida en el perfil de Nahuel
Descripción truncada — no se puede ver la totalidad de requisitos y compensación

title: Functional Consultant (Finance Systems / ERP Implementation)
description:
Who We Are

Launchpad Technologies Inc. is a global technology partner connecting top talent with high-impact projects across North America and beyond. We specialize in Staff Augmentation and product development, helping companies scale with agility while empowering professionals to grow in meaningful, remote-first environments.

About the Role

Have you started your career in Finance, Accounting, Accounts Payable, Procurement, or Business Administration and later discovered that you enjoyed implementing financial systems more than running the processes themselves? Maybe you began as an Accountant, AP Analyst, Financial Analyst, Procurement Specialist, or Business Consultant before transitioning into ERP or SaaS implementations.

If you understand financial operations because you've actually worked in them, and now enjoy helping customers transform those processes through technology, we'd love to meet you.

We are partnering with a global leader in cloud-based Spend Management and Accounts Payable Automation solutions trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide. As part of this strategic partnership, we're building a specialized Professional Services team that will guide international customers through the successful implementation of the AP Automation platform.

This is a customer-facing consulting role where you'll combine your finance knowledge, analytical thinking, and implementation experience to help organizations modernize the way they purchase, approve invoices, manage suppliers, and automate financial operations.

Start date: Not defined - We are continuously adding new members to this growing team
Contract type: Contractor, Full-Time, 100% Remote
Work hours: Monday to Friday, 7.30 am to 4.30 pm PST

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Functional Consultant, you'll becom
resumen: Rol de consultor funcional para implementación de ERP/SaaS de Spend Management y automatización de Cuentas por Pagar. Launchpad Technologies es una empresa global de staff augmentation que conecta talento con proyectos en Norteamérica.
por_que_encaja: Nahuel tiene experiencia en análisis de procesos financieros y presentaciones a dirección, lo que toca tangencialmente el perfil. Sin embargo, el core del rol es implementación de ERP/AP Automation, no análisis de datos ni BI.
brecha_stack: El rol exige experiencia directa en implementación de ERP o SaaS (Coupa, SAP, Oracle, Basware u similares), conocimiento profundo de procesos de AP/Procurement/Finance operacional, y consultoría de implementación funcional — nada de esto está en el stack de Nahuel como Data Analyst. Python, SQL, Power BI y forecasting no son relevantes aquí.
posibilidad_real: Baja — el rol es de consultor de implementación ERP/finanzas operacionales, no de análisis de datos. Nahuel no tiene experiencia en implementaciones de sistemas ni en AP Automation, que es el núcleo no negociable del puesto.
red_flags: Horario fijo PST (7:30am-4:30pm) puede ser restrictivo desde Córdoba (diferencia de 4-5 horas según horario de verano/invierno)
El rol requiere experiencia en implementación funcional de ERP/SaaS — una transición de carrera que la oferta describe explícitamente, no el perfil de Nahuel
Contrato contractor, no empleado — implica gestión fiscal individual

title: Change Management Consultant
description:
NTT DATA is a team of more than 190,000 diverse professionals, operating in more than 50 countries throughout the world. The sectors where we have activities include: telecommunications, finance, industry, utilities, energy, public administration and health.

Our mission? Offer technological solutions, business, strategy, development and maintenance of applications, while being a benchmark in consulting. All thanks to the collaboration between teams, the human quality of our people and the fact that we do not conform to what is established, we always seek innovation that brings us closer to the future.

Our essence has led us to the forefront of technology, breaking paradigms and providing solutions that truly respond to the needs of each client. Our talent has led us to be one of the top 6 technology companies in the world.

Because #Greattech, needs #GreatPeople, like you

NTT DATA is looking for high-achieving team players that are quickly adaptable to new challenges and entrepreneurial ventures. We are looking for a Change Management Consultant to work remotely in LATAM with our global clients.

Overview:

We’re seeking a Change Management Consultant to support the successful delivery of digital transformation initiatives across SAP, Salesforce, data, and AI programs. This role works closely with client stakeholders and technical teams to drive adoption, manage change activities, and ensure business outcomes are realized. The position offers hands-on exposure to a dynamic, client-facing environment with opportunities to lead engagement strategies and deliver measurable impact across organizations.

Responsibilities:

  • Define end-to-end Change Management strategy and execution across technology programs.
  • Conduct stakeholder identification, mapping, and engagement planning at all levels.
  • Perform impact assessments a
resumen: Rol de Change Management Consultant para NTT DATA, enfocado en gestión del cambio organizacional en proyectos de transformación digital (SAP, Salesforce, IA). Es consultoría de procesos y adopción tecnológica, no análisis de datos.
por_que_encaja: El contexto de transformación digital con IA y la exposición a stakeholders es familiar para Nahuel, pero el rol pide competencias específicas de change management (PROSCI/ADKAR, gestión de adopción organizacional) que no son su perfil central.
brecha_stack: El rol no pide Python, SQL, BI ni forecasting — pide metodologías de change management (PROSCI, ADKAR, gestión de comunicaciones organizacionales, planes de training), experiencia en implementaciones SAP/Salesforce y consultoría de adopción. No es un rol de datos.
posibilidad_real: Baja — Nahuel tiene experiencia de stakeholder management pero no en change management formal; sin metodologías certificadas ni experiencia en implementaciones SAP/Salesforce, sería candidato débil.
red_flags: El rol es Change Management puro, no data/analytics — el fit de perfil es bajo y competiría contra consultores especializados en PROSCI/ADKAR
SAP y Salesforce como plataformas centrales del rol son ajenas al stack de Nahuel
